# Scratch

> A floating spreadsheet for macOS with formulas, notes and clipboard capture.

Every page is Markdown at the same URL with `.md` added. The full set is in /llms-full.txt and a JSON index is at /search.json.

- [Scratch](https://scratch.itsryan.me/index.md): what it is and how to install it
- [Source](https://github.com/rynf1t/scratch-site)

## Start

- [Getting started](https://scratch.itsryan.me/docs/getting-started.md): Open Scratch and calculate your first total.

## Guides

- [Grid and shortcuts](https://scratch.itsryan.me/docs/grid.md): Move, edit, format and calculate from the keyboard.
- [Capture and paste](https://scratch.itsryan.me/docs/capture.md): Bring in clipboard amounts, screenshots and delimited text.
- [Notes and Obsidian](https://scratch.itsryan.me/docs/notes-and-obsidian.md): Link notes to live cells and send the table and notes to your vault.
- [Formula Microscope](https://scratch.itsryan.me/docs/formula-microscope.md): See how a formula evaluates and jump to the cells behind its result.
- [Selection History](https://scratch.itsryan.me/docs/history.md): Compare earlier cell entries and recover a range without rolling back the sheet.
- [Record and Replay](https://scratch.itsryan.me/docs/replay.md): Save a sequence of grid commands and run it on another range.

## Start

- [Keyboard Shortcuts](https://scratch.itsryan.me/docs/shortcuts.md): Choose your own shortcuts for Notes, the command palette and capture.
